description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Controlling higher-mode seismic responses in reinforced concrete core wall buildings using force-limiting floor-to-wall connections is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Georgios Tsampras, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This poster focuses on the seismic response of a three-dimensional eighteen-story reinforced concrete core wall building model with modified friction-based force-limiting connections (Modified FDs) between the floors and reinforced concrete core wall. Coverage: College Park, MD. DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-q1vy-sb09. Keywords: higher-mode seismic responses; force-limiting connections; friction-based connections; reinforced concrete core wall buildings. Published 2024-06-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
